ordway$`Date/Time` <- as.POSIXct(
  as.character(ordway$`Date/Time`),
  format = "%m/%d/%y %H:%M"
)

ordway$PAR <- as.numeric(ordway$PAR)

ggplot(ordway, aes(x = `Date/Time`, y = PAR)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Photosynthetically Active Radiation Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "PAR (umol/s/m²)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#colSums(is.na(ordway))

```{r}
weather_messy <- read.csv('/Users/shayleeogrady/Documents/macalester/fall 2026/data sci/ds212-project-group-5/data/raw/DNRWeatherData.csv')
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

weather_2013 <- weather_messy |>
  rename(
    max_temp_f    = Maximum.Temperature.degrees..F.,
    min_temp_f    = Minimum.Temperature.degrees..F.,
    precip_in     = Precipitation..inches.,
    snow_in       = Snow..inches.,
    snow_depth_in = Snow.Depth..inches.
  ) |>
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) |>
  filter(year(Date) == 2013) |>
  # "T" = trace amount -> 0; blanks -> NA; then make numeric
  mutate(across(c(precip_in, snow_in, snow_depth_in),
                ~ as.character(.x) |>
                  na_if("") |>
                  na_if("T") |>   # temporary, replaced below
                  as.numeric() |>
                  coalesce(if_else(as.character(.x) == "T", 0, NA_real_))))

write_csv(weather_2013, "weather.csv")
```
